tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional Digital Commerce Specialist | SAP Commerce Cloud | Requirements, Integrations & Agile Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce specialist with 5+ years of experience delivering and scaling global enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines deep technical proficiency in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs and ERP/PIM integrations with hands-on business analysis, requirements engineering, user story creation and process mapping. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User experienced in driving end-to-end commerce features across international agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Commerce
cover_en.hook: HEINEKEN's ambition to pioneer connected B2B and B2C digital commerce across global markets demands digital platforms that effortlessly balance operational reality with commercial growth. With over five years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge technical architecture and business vision to turn complex digital commerce roadmaps into high-impact solutions.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & Backlog Ownership
bullets.text: Analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, authored detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, and delivered functional specifications across B2B and B2C commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: Commerce Platform Delivery
bullets.text: Delivered and extended core commerce capabilities on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211), including Order Management (OMS), Promotions Engine, product catalog management, and headless OCC APIs.

bullets.label: Omnichannel & Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Designed and optimized critical data flows and APIs between SAP ERP, PIM (Profisee), MDM, and commerce frontends, resolving data bottlenecks with international stakeholders to ensure reliable catalog and ordering experiences.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & UAT Leadership
bullets.text: Drove delivery within Agile/Scrum environments using Jira, Confluence, and PI Planning, facilitating process mapping and guiding business stakeholders through user acceptance testing (UAT) to secure seamless production rollouts.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work and residence permit (no sponsorship required), and am currently serving my notice period with a contractual earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional commerce experience can advance HEINEKEN's digital product initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: HEINEKEN's digital transformation at scale requires platforms that unite global reach with localized commercial execution. I want to bring my background in high-volume enterprise commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105/2211) and techno-functional requirement translation to HEINEKEN Global Shared Services, helping deliver reliable, market-leading ordering and engagement experiences for customers worldwide.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years translating business needs into high-performing SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to drive customer-centric digital commerce products and scalable platform features for HEINEKEN's global operations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I noticed the Product Owner Digital Commerce role at HEINEKEN Global Shared Services. With 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience bridging business requirements, user stories, and technical delivery at Shell and Rockwell, I'd welcome the chance to connect.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner Digital Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Product Owner Digital Commerce position at HEINEKEN Global Shared Services. With over five years of enterprise experience on SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on experience in business requirements analysis, user story definition, and cross-functional agile delivery. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my techno-functional commerce background aligns with your digital roadmap.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
